## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and trust boundary affected.

## Evidence

- [ ] `npm run audit:public`
- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has focused synthetic tests
- [ ] Documentation and permission/dependency notes are current
- [ ] No personal data, absolute private paths, runtime output, secrets, or generated build files are included
